        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Metal de las cubas -->

        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"

        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="ls54-metal-stop" />

      <!-- Franja inferior de las cubas -->

        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"

        <stop offset="75%" class="ls54-liquid-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#92C3DE" />

      <!-- Metal de los accesorios -->

        <stop offset="75%" class="ls54-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#BFC3C9" />

      <!-- Sombra suave de las poleas -->
      <filter
        id="ls54-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%"
        y="-30%"
        width="160%"
        height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="rollerAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerAmbientBlur"
          dx="0.3"
          dy="2"
          result="rollerAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="rollerAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerAmbientColor"
          in2="rollerAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="rollerContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.65"
          result="rollerContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="rollerContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerContactColor"
          in2="rollerContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="rollerContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra suave de las cubas -->
      <filter
        id="ls54-tank-shadow"
        x="-5%"
        y="-30%"
        width="110%"
        height="175%"

        <feGaussianBlur

          stdDeviation="2"
          result="tankAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankAmbientBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="2.5"
          result="tankAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="tankAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankAmbientColor"
          in2="tankAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur

          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="tankContactBlur"
        />

          dx="0"

        />

          result="tankContactColor"
        />

          in="tankContactColor"
          in2="tankContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
